text: Protein shakes will destroy your kidneys!
If that were true, every gym would be a hospital. So what is whey, really?
Whey is just milk protein, filtered and dried. It's a complete protein, it digests fast, and it's rich in leucine.
In healthy people, studies haven't shown higher-protein diets harming the kidneys.
Use a scoop when food alone doesn't hit your protein target. Isolate has less lactose, if dairy bothers you.
Verdict: worth it for convenience. Have kidney disease? Talk to your doctor. Save this.
